Role overview

Learn Sales the Way It Actually Happens.

At Weekday AI, you won't spend your internship shadowing someone else. You'll be on the phone from week one.

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) Intern on our Contingency team, you'll reach out to companies, start conversations with decision-makers, and book demos for our recruitment-as-a-service offering. Every demo you book is a direct contribution to the company's revenue pipeline

You don't need to come in knowing sales. If you communicate well, can handle a "no" and keep going, and want to get better every day, we'll teach you the rest

About Weekday AI

Weekday AI is building a better way for companies to hire engineering talent. Our platform helps companies find high-quality, peer-recommended candidates through intelligent sourcing, automated outreach, and instant reference checks.

Through our Contingency service, we work as an extension of a company's hiring team and deliver vetted candidates for its open roles.

We're a lean, fast-moving, Y Combinator-backed startup where people take ownership early and see the impact of their work

What You'll Do

  • Make outbound calls to prospective customers, about 100 dials a day.
  • Have first conversations with founders, hiring managers, and HR leaders about their hiring needs.

  • Book qualified demos for the sales team, with a target of 2 a day.

  • Communication: how to speak clearly and confidently with decision-makers

Who We're Looking For

  • Communicates clearly and confidently on the phone

  • Is target-driven and enjoys measurable goals
  • Is consistent and disciplined about daily activity
  • Learns quickly and acts on feedback

Prior sales or calling experience is a bonus, not a requirement. What matters most is your communication, energy, and willingness to put in the reps

Why Weekday?

  • Real conversations. You'll talk to real decision-makers at real companies every day.
  • Real impact. Every demo you book feeds directly into revenue.
  • Real learning. You'll learn by doing, with coaching from the people who do it every day.
  • Real rewards. On top of the fixed stipend, you'll earn a performance incentive for hitting your targets.

If you want an internship where you learn fast, own clear targets, and build skills that stay with you long after it ends, apply.

We will need you as the guiding force in automating our marketing to pull this off. You'll work in collaboration with our Senior Marketing Generalists to focus their time on where it counts.

You'll also be part of our internal tech team, because ultimately the data and leads will be populated into our existing custom CRM.

Your primary objective is to build and maintain the marketing infrastructure that allows us to scale from five offers to over 100 by the end of the year.

You won't be just "running ads"—you will be building the machines and systems that help the marketing team run more ads, create better ads, test more ads, and iterate more marketing funnels, faster, more efficiently, and with less mistakes.

You will also have access to top-notch marketing resources via a high-end mastermind and coaching platform that we are part of.

  5. Adaptability: The AI landscape changes constantly. You must be a “constant learner” who researches, goes down rabbit holes, and learns about new AI apps, models, and automation systems to stay ahead of the curve and provide our marketers with the best automation solutions available.
